What's changing

Useful updates, clearer funding information and ideas that make daily life a little easier.

The big update · 1 October 2026

Some support budgets are changing.

The NDIS is reducing some funding in Social, Economic & Community Participation and Improved Daily Living Skills as plans are created or reassessed. Renewed plans are affected from 1 February 2027.

Good to know: Essential supports such as personal care, cleaning and personal mobility equipment are not included in these particular reductions.
Read the official NDIS changes
COMING 1 DECEMBER

New NDIS price limits

House / yard maintenance$63.42/hrwas $59.01 ↑ 7.5%
House cleaning$64.59/hrwas $60.10 ↑ 7.5%
Personal domestic activities$65.73/hrwas $61.16 ↑ 7.5%
Specialised home help for a child$65.73/hrwas $61.16 ↑ 7.5%

All four rise by about 7.5% from 1 December. These are maximum NDIS price limits, not automatic changes to your agreement.

Technology worth a look

NEW MOBILITY TECH

A new compact power chair just landed

Permobil’s M4 Nexa launched in Australia this month, combining a compact base, low seat height, full power seating and built-in connectivity.

Explore the M4 Nexa
ACCESSIBILITY APP

Let your phone or tablet describe what’s around you

Microsoft Seeing AI can read text, identify products and describe nearby people, objects and scenes aloud.

Discover Seeing AI
SMART HOME ACCESS

Control more of home with less effort

Voice and app controls can help with lights, doors, blinds, reminders and everyday routines — useful when reach or hand function is limited.

Explore smart-home accessibility

Funding depends on your plan, needs and relevant evidence. Everyday consumer devices are not automatically NDIS-funded.
